correctness.rationale: The original 3D algebraic equations are reduced with exact converse for nonzero abscissa; the exceptional axial case is solved separately. The polynomial F has 12000P discriminant and squarefree P with exactly two simple negative zeros by rational Sturm arithmetic. Test-parameter counts, double-root subresultants and nonzero rational interval enclosures prove all census transitions and ordinary folds. The explicitly derived center projection proves the transcritical bifurcation. CHECK.py was executed successfully, and its critical sign computations have exact rational certificates; the proof does not conflate bounded computation with infinite search.

originality.rationale: The full founding arXiv preprint limits equilibrium analysis to nonnegative rho and explicitly identifies negative rho as future work. A highly similar public result was fully read: it derives the same P but its theorem and deductions are entirely for nonnegative rho. The complete negative-parameter census and generic fold/transcritical coefficients are not consequences of that restricted theorem, and targeted successful semantic searches did not identify a dominating earlier result. Residual unindexed prior equivalence is disclosed.

value.rationale: The original recent paper explicitly leaves negative-parameter bifurcations to future research. This is a natural complete parameter-half-line equilibrium classification with four-to-zero nonzero-branch progression, two exact folds, an exceptionally close transcritical event, exceptional-axis handling and different transverse fold types. It motivates and structurally constrains follow-up analysis of the flow without claiming global chaos or dynamics.
